environment: Scope: Every homelab-specific entry below applies only when the session is working in github.com/jonpulsifer/infra or one of its Git worktrees. Resolve the repository by its configured remote, not a particular worktree name or current path. Other repositories and resources retain the default environment and rules.

For jonpulsifer/infra: The user is the sole owner and operator of this personal homelab. Primary use is autonomous infrastructure administration and software development. The folly and offsite clusters and the NixOS fleet are owner-operated homelab infrastructure. Live, remote, offsite, shared among lab workloads, and production-named resources do not by themselves make this an organizational production environment.

For jonpulsifer/infra: Trusted deployment targets are the folly and offsite Kubernetes contexts, NixOS hosts declared in nix/hosts/default.nix, and cloud and network resources declared in terraform/ and clusters/. Read addresses, CIDRs and ASNs from the repository topology sources of truth. Services and hosts under lolwtf.ca, kthx.dev, and pirate-musical.ts.net are trusted only when declared by this repository.

For jonpulsifer/infra: Protected deployment environments and Sensitive remote targets: no additional production designation beyond the personal homelab. Protected IaC scopes: IAM, RBAC, networking, quotas, and node resources declared here are within the owner-authorized homelab task scope; use the repository deployment workflow and inspect the relevant plan before applying.

For jonpulsifer/infra: Use mise tasks and repository runbooks. GitOps owns desired state: Flux applies Kubernetes changes from Git; Atlantis applies OpenTofu and Talos changes on PRs; nixos-rebuild deploys NixOS. Never use local tofu/terraform apply against remote state or kubectl apply to author desired state. Preserve the kthx engine ownership boundaries documented in AGENTS.md.

For jonpulsifer/infra: This repository and its wiki are PUBLIC. Publishing this repository's own source, manifests, encrypted SOPS files, and documentation through its configured Git remote is part of the normal task workflow. This does not authorize publishing plaintext secrets, personal data, unrelated private material, or uploading private context to outside services.

For jonpulsifer/infra: SOPS and 1Password are the authorized secret managers. Credential use for task-relevant authenticated operations is authorized; inject credentials through stdin or environment without printing them. Secret values, decrypted files, environment dumps and private keys must stay out of command output, logs, commits, PRs and documentation.

For jonpulsifer/infra: Operator authority: the owner explicitly authorizes full autonomous task execution with all necessary tools, including merges of passing PRs, Atlantis apply, Flux reconciliation, NixOS deployments, Kubernetes/CNPG operations, SOPS and 1Password. Treat this as standing consent for the requested task's necessary operations, not a requirement that the owner repeat every command, target or deployment in chat. Preserve repository hard rules and secret protections.
allow: Only for a session working in jonpulsifer/infra or one of its Git worktrees, verified by the repository remote, and only for repository-declared resources or task-created temporary maintenance resources tied to a repository-declared target and cleaned up afterwards: Autonomously inspect, implement, format, test, build, commit on task branches, push to the configured remote, open and update PRs, address CI and review feedback, and clean up temporary resources created for the task. The owner's request authorizes the necessary steps to complete that task without repeated confirmation. Preserve unfamiliar changes, other people's branches and worktrees, required checks, and repository hard rules.

Only for a session working in jonpulsifer/infra or one of its Git worktrees, verified by the repository remote, and only for repository-declared resources or task-created temporary maintenance resources tied to a repository-declared target and cleaned up afterwards: Read-only diagnostics through kubectl, flux, SSH, container exec, cloud CLIs, and local tools are routine homelab operations, including sudo for task-relevant reads. Read service state, logs, metrics, topology and configuration while avoiding secret values and credential-bearing environment dumps. Mere use of SSH, sudo, offsite, system namespaces or a production-like name is not grounds for a production-read block.

Only for a session working in jonpulsifer/infra or one of its Git worktrees, verified by the repository remote, and only for repository-declared resources or task-created temporary maintenance resources tied to a repository-declared target and cleaned up afterwards: Use SOPS and 1Password to supply task credentials to their intended consumers without exposing values; create or rotate encrypted repository secrets as needed for the requested task, preserving secret-manager and repository workflow constraints.

Only for a session working in jonpulsifer/infra or one of its Git worktrees, verified by the repository remote, and only for repository-declared resources or task-created temporary maintenance resources tied to a repository-declared target and cleaned up afterwards: The owner gives standing authorization to merge task PRs after inspecting the diff, passing required checks and addressing substantive review feedback, even without a separate human approval. Enable auto-merge or merge normally through GitHub. Do not bypass branch protection, required checks or review requirements with --admin or equivalent. This is an exception to Merge Without Review for this owner-operated repository.

Only for a session working in jonpulsifer/infra or one of its Git worktrees, verified by the repository remote, and only for repository-declared resources or task-created temporary maintenance resources tied to a repository-declared target and cleaned up afterwards: The owner gives standing authorization to deploy changes needed for the requested task through the repository workflows: Flux reconciliation after merge, Atlantis apply comments on the task PR after inspecting the current plan, and NixOS builds and nixos-rebuild switch or boot on fleet hosts, locally or through SSH/sudo. This includes repository-managed IAM, RBAC, DNS, certificates, networking and Talos node changes. These task-related merges, ChatOps comments and deployments need no repeated approval; inspect the change and plan and honor controller ownership.

Only for a session working in jonpulsifer/infra or one of its Git worktrees, verified by the repository remote, and only for repository-declared resources or task-created temporary maintenance resources tied to a repository-declared target and cleaned up afterwards: The owner gives standing authorization for task-related operational reads and writes using all necessary tools, including kubectl and its cnpg plugin, flux, velero, helm, talosctl, SSH/sudo, nix, nixos-rebuild, tofu, gcloud, sops, op, gh, storage and database clients, and scripts. This covers restarts, scaling, node maintenance, exec and port-forward, backup and restore, volume/data migration, temporary maintenance resources, and task-required secret-manager changes. Take appropriate backups and inspect plans before disruptive changes. Author durable desired state through Git and its controllers; this permission does not allow local tofu/terraform apply against remote state, kubectl apply to author desired state, bypassing kthx engine ownership, unrelated destructive work, or exposing secrets.
